references.text: The prophet Isaiah speaks of a servant who will suffer and offer his life for many, which foreshadows Jesus' sacrifice.
A psalm that points to one who serves others rather than himself, in line with Jesus' example.
Hebrews speaks of Jesus offering himself once for all, reflecting Jesus' words about giving his life as a ransom.
1 Peter describes how Jesus bore our sins in his body on the cross, which aligns with Jesus' self-sacrifice.
